phase_name: Add the two new gates to check-extension-docs.sh

objectives.description: Add Rule R (per-extension line_count accuracy) and Rule S (project-wide deployed-index-orphan), sibling severity variable, header/rule-index docs; verify with negative tests

approaches_tried.approach: Rule S using the existing _git_deployed_files (git ls-files) helper, matching Rule L's precedent
approaches_tried.reason: This repository's .gitignore blanket-excludes /.claude/ with no tracked exceptions, so git ls-files .claude/context always returns zero results here -- the rule would be silently vacuous, never failing regardless of real orphans.

deviations.description: Rule S enumerates the filesystem directly (find -name '*.md') instead of reusing _git_deployed_files, because .claude/ is entirely gitignored in this repository
deviations.reason: git ls-files against a fully gitignored .claude/ tree returns nothing, which would make the new gate (and, latently, the pre-existing Rule L) unable to ever detect an orphan. Discovered empirically by placing a scratch file and observing it absent from git ls-files output. Fixing Rule L itself is out of scope for this phase.
deviations.annotation: documented in check_deployed_index_orphans's comment and in the plan's Phase 7 task checklist
